Radio settings

Edit bands, digital frequencies, files, and time. Changes apply to this radio’s SD card.

Bands

Add, edit, or remove bands. Use Active to bind a band to the up/down buttons.

Open bands →

Digital

Set FT8 / FT4 frequencies for each band.

Open digital →

Files

Download ADI logs, screenshots, and recordings from the DATA partition.

Browse files →

Time

Set the radio clock.

Open time →

Files tip: If you download params.db while the radio is writing, the copy may be incomplete. The file on the radio is fine — reopen the download if needed.
